Attaching blocks to any other side requires the use of glue
create.ponder.sail.text_2: They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of glue or chassis blocks
create.ponder.sail_frame.text_2: They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of glue or chassis blocks
create.ponder.shared.movement_anchors: With the help of glue, larger structures can be moved
create.ponder.super_glue.text_1: Glue groups blocks together into moving contraptions
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_2: Create a movable structure with the help of glue
item.create.netherite_diving_helmet.tool: Together with a _Infernite Backtank_, this can protect you from _extreme heat_. To be effective, _Legs and Feet_ have to be covered in _Infernite_, too.
lore.create.sweet_roll: A soft bread roll filled with milk. More filling than a plain loaf.

lore.create.andesite_table_cloth: A metal cover that can be placed over a table. Shopkeepers can set prices on items placed on it for a Stock Ticker shop.
lore.create.andesite_scaffolding: Metal scaffolding that can be climbed and traversed like Bamboo Scaffolding. It can be encased with a casing block.
lore.create.andesite_ladder: A metal ladder that can be climbed. It can be encased with a casing block.
lore.create.brass_table_cloth: A metal cover that can be placed over a table. Shopkeepers can set prices on items placed on it for a Stock Ticker shop.
lore.create.brass_scaffolding: Metal scaffolding that can be climbed and traversed like Bamboo Scaffolding. It can be encased with a casing block.
lore.create.brass_ladder: A metal ladder that can be climbed. It can be encased with a casing block.
lore.create.copper_table_cloth: A metal cover that can be placed over a table. Shopkeepers can set prices on items placed on it for a Stock Ticker shop.
lore.create.copper_scaffolding: Metal scaffolding that can be climbed and traversed like Bamboo Scaffolding. It can be encased with a casing block.
lore.create.copper_ladder: A metal ladder that can be climbed. It can be encased with a casing block.
lore.create.shaft: The simplest way to carry Rotational Force in a straight line. Cut from Bronze.
lore.create.cogwheel: A small gear that passes Rotational Force to shafts and to adjacent Cogwheels, reversing the direction.
lore.create.large_cogwheel: A large gear that passes Rotational Force on. Pair it diagonally with a small Cogwheel to double or halve the speed.
lore.create.gearbox: A block that passes Rotational Force out of all four sides around its axis, reversing some directions.
lore.create.clutch: A shaft that stops transmitting Rotational Force while it's given Flux Power.
lore.create.gearshift: A shaft that reverses the direction of Rotational Force while it's given Flux Power.
lore.create.encased_chain_drive: A block that passes Rotational Force to other Chain Drives placed in a line next to it.
lore.create.adjustable_chain_gearshift: A Chain Drive that changes the speed it passes on based on the Flux signal it receives.
lore.create.belt_connector: A belt that can be stretched between two shafts to carry items and entities, and to pass on Rotational Force.
lore.create.chain_conveyor: A wheel that strings chains between other conveyors so Packages can travel overhead. Also passes Rotational Force on.
lore.create.water_wheel: A wheel that generates Rotational Force from flowing water running over or past it.
lore.create.large_water_wheel: A huge wheel that generates more Rotational Force than a regular Water Wheel, but turns slower.
lore.create.nozzle: Attach to the front of an Encased Fan to spread its effect on entities in all directions.
lore.create.turntable: A platform that spins anything standing on it using Rotational Force.
lore.create.hand_crank: A crank that generates a small amount of Rotational Force for as long as you keep turning it.
lore.create.cuckoo_clock: A decorative clock that shows the time. It chimes at noon and at nightfall.
lore.create.crushing_wheel: A wheel that, paired with another turning the opposite way, crushes items dropped between them into Crushed Ores and other products.
lore.create.mechanical_press: A machine that presses items below it into Sheets, or compacts items in a Basin.
lore.create.mechanical_mixer: A machine that mixes items and fluids in a Basin below it. Some recipes need heat from a Blaze Burner.
lore.create.basin: A bowl that holds items and fluids for a Mechanical Mixer or Press to work on.
lore.create.empty_blaze_burner: A cage made to hold a Blaze. Use it on a Blaze or a Monster Spawner to capture one.
lore.create.blaze_burner: A captured Blaze that heats a Basin above it. Feed it fuel to keep it burning, or a Blaze Cake to superheat it.
lore.create.depot: A platform that holds a single stack of items for machines to work on.
lore.create.weighted_ejector: A spring-loaded platform that launches items and entities on it to a target you set with a wrench.
lore.create.chute: A vertical pipe that moves items up or down. Fans can push items upwards through it.
lore.create.smart_chute: A Chute with a filter that only lets matching items through.
lore.create.speedometer: A gauge that shows how fast the Rotational Force running through it is turning.
lore.create.stressometer: A gauge that shows how much stress a kinetic network is under compared to its capacity.
lore.create.wooden_bracket: A decorative wooden brace for Shafts, Cogwheels, and Pipes.
lore.create.metal_bracket: A decorative metal brace for Shafts, Cogwheels, and Pipes.
lore.create.fluid_pipe: A pipe that carries fluids when pushed by a Mechanical Pump.
lore.create.mechanical_pump: A pump that pushes fluids through Fluid Pipes using Rotational Force.
lore.create.smart_fluid_pipe: A Fluid Pipe with a filter that only lets a matching fluid through.
lore.create.fluid_valve: A pipe that opens or closes when Rotational Force is applied to it.
lore.create.fluid_tank: A tank for storing fluids. Placing tanks next to each other merges them into a larger one.
lore.create.hose_pulley: A machine that lowers a hose to drain or fill large bodies of fluid. A big enough body of water counts as infinite.
lore.create.item_drain: A grate that empties fluids out of items placed or dropped on it.
lore.create.spout: A machine that pours fluid into items below it, filling bottles and buckets or coating items.
lore.create.portable_fluid_interface: Lets pipes pump fluids in and out of tanks on a moving contraption that stops next to it.
lore.create.steam_engine: An engine that generates a lot of Rotational Force when attached to a heated Fluid Tank full of water.
lore.create.steam_whistle: A whistle that blows when attached to a heated Fluid Tank and given Flux Power. Stack them for deeper notes.
lore.create.mechanical_piston: A piston that pushes a structure out along Piston Extension Poles using Rotational Force.
lore.create.sticky_mechanical_piston: A Mechanical Piston that also pulls the structure in front of it back.
lore.create.piston_extension_pole: A pole that sets how far a Mechanical Piston can extend.
lore.create.gantry_carriage: A carriage that moves along a Gantry Shaft, carrying any blocks attached to it.
lore.create.gantry_shaft: A shaft that moves Gantry Carriages along it when powered with Rotational Force.
lore.create.windmill_bearing: A bearing that turns a structure of sails into a windmill, generating Rotational Force.
lore.create.mechanical_bearing: A bearing that rotates the structure attached to its face using Rotational Force.
lore.create.clockwork_bearing: A bearing that turns attached structures to match the time of day, like the hands of a clock.
lore.create.rope_pulley: A pulley that lowers and raises attached structures on a rope.
lore.create.elevator_pulley: A pulley that runs a lift between floors marked by Elevator Contacts.
lore.create.controller_rail: A one-way powered rail whose speed is set by the strength of the Flux signal it gets.
lore.create.linear_chassis: A frame that moves the blocks glued to its sides along with a contraption.
lore.create.radial_chassis: A frame that moves the blocks around it in a radius along with a contraption.
lore.create.sticker: A block that sticks to the block in front of it when powered, letting contraptions grab and release blocks.
lore.create.contraption_controls: A switch on moving contraptions that turns their tools and actors on and off.
lore.create.mechanical_saw: A saw that cuts logs into planks and cuts down trees in front of it.
lore.create.deployer: A mechanical arm that uses, places, or applies the item it holds, just like a player would.
lore.create.portable_storage_interface: Lets items be moved in and out of a moving contraption's storage when it stops next to it.
lore.create.redstone_contact: A pair of contacts that sends a Flux signal when they face each other, even on moving contraptions.
lore.create.andesite_casing: A Bronze-plated casing used to make kinetic components. Apply Bronze to a stripped log to make it.
lore.create.brass_casing: A Brass-plated casing used to make advanced kinetic components.
lore.create.copper_casing: A Copper-plated casing used to make fluid components.
lore.create.mechanical_crafter: A crafting machine. Arrange several of them into a grid to craft larger recipes automatically.
lore.create.sequenced_gearshift: A gearshift that runs a programmed list of turns, waits, and speed changes when powered.
lore.create.flywheel: A big decorative Brass wheel for embellishing your machines.
lore.create.rotation_speed_controller: A controller that sets the speed of a large Cogwheel above it.
lore.create.mechanical_arm: An arm that picks up items from one place and puts them in another. Set its inputs and outputs before placing it.
lore.create.andesite_funnel: A funnel that pulls items in and out of inventories or off belts.
lore.create.brass_funnel: A Funnel that can filter items and move them a stack at a time.
lore.create.andesite_tunnel: A cover for Mechanical Belts that splits items evenly between neighbouring belts.
lore.create.brass_tunnel: A Tunnel that can filter and distribute items in many ways.
lore.create.content_observer: An observer that gives a Flux signal when a filtered item or fluid passes by or is stored in front of it.
lore.create.stockpile_switch: A switch that gives a Flux signal based on how full the container it's attached to is.
lore.create.item_vault: A large, cheap item store. Vaults placed next to each other merge into one.
lore.create.item_hatch: A hatch on an Item Vault that lets you dump your inventory straight into it.
lore.create.packager: A machine that wraps items from an inventory into Cardboard Packages, or unwraps packages it receives.
lore.create.cardboard_package_12x10: A box of items made by a Packager. Open it by hand or send it to its address.
lore.create.package: A box of items made by a Packager. Open it by hand or send it to its address.
lore.create.cardboard_package_10x8: A box of items made by a Packager. Open it by hand or send it to its address.
lore.create.cardboard_package_10x12: A box of items made by a Packager. Open it by hand or send it to its address.
lore.create.cardboard_package_12x12: A box of items made by a Packager. Open it by hand or send it to its address.
lore.create.repackager: A machine that merges and splits Packages so orders arrive together.
lore.create.package_frogport: A frog that catches Packages off Chain Conveyors and spits them into the container below.
lore.create.stock_link: Connects a Packager's inventory to a logistics network so Stock Tickers can see and order from it.
lore.create.stock_ticker: A counter that lists everything in a logistics network and lets you order items from it.
lore.create.redstone_requester: A block that places a set order on a logistics network whenever it's powered.
lore.create.factory_gauge: A gauge that keeps a set amount of an item stocked by ordering more from the network.
lore.create.display_link: A link that reads information from a block and writes it to a Display Board, Nixie Tube, or Sign.
lore.create.display_board: A large board for showing text sent by a Display Link.
lore.create.nixie_tube: A small display that shows the strength of the Flux signal it's given, or text from a Display Link.
lore.create.redstone_link: A wireless Flux transmitter. Links tuned to the same pair of items share their signal.
lore.create.analog_lever: A lever that can be set to any Flux signal strength from 0 to 15.
lore.create.pulse_repeater: A repeater that turns any signal it's given into a single short pulse.
lore.create.pulse_extender: A repeater that stretches a short signal into a longer one.
lore.create.pulse_timer: A clock that sends out a pulse at a regular interval you can set.
lore.create.powered_latch: A latch that turns on when powered from the back and off when powered from the side.
lore.create.powered_toggle_latch: A latch that flips between on and off each time it's powered.
lore.create.propeller: A crafting component used to make Encased Fans.
lore.create.whisk: A crafting component used to make Mechanical Mixers.
lore.create.brass_hand: A crafting component used to make Deployers and Mechanical Arms.
lore.create.crafter_slot_cover: A cover that blocks a Mechanical Crafter's slot so recipes with gaps line up.
lore.create.electron_tube: A crafting component made from Polished Rose Quartz, used in Flux and logistics devices.
lore.create.transmitter: A crafting component used to make wireless devices like Flux Links and Display Links.
lore.create.precision_mechanism: An intricate component made on a sequenced assembly line. Used for advanced machinery.
lore.create.blaze_cake: A treat for Blaze Burners that superheats them for a while.
lore.create.blaze_cake_base: An unfinished Blaze Cake. Fill it with Lava using a Spout to finish it.
lore.create.minecart_coupling: Chains two Minecarts together so they move as one.
lore.create.filter: A filter that matches against a list of items or other filters. Used in the filter slots of machines.
lore.create.attribute_filter: A filter that matches items by their attributes or categories. Used in the filter slots of machines.
lore.create.package_filter: A filter that matches Packages by their address. Used in the filter slots of machines.
lore.create.wrench: A tool for rotating and picking up kinetic components. Sneak-use to pick a component up instantly.
lore.create.schematic_table: Writes saved Schematics onto an Empty Schematic so they can be built with a Schematicannon.
lore.create.schematic_and_quill: A tool for selecting an area of the world and saving it as a Schematic.
lore.create.empty_schematic: A blank Schematic, ready to be written at a Schematic Table.
lore.create.linked_controller: A handheld remote with six buttons, each of which can be tied to a Flux Link frequency.
lore.create.clipboard: A clipboard for writing notes and checklists. It can also copy and paste machine settings.
lore.create.goggles: Goggles that show extra information about kinetic and fluid machines when worn.
lore.create.super_glue: A brush for gluing blocks together so they move as one contraption. Select an area by clicking two corners.
lore.create.crafting_blueprint: A blueprint that hangs on a wall and remembers recipes, letting you fill a Crafting Table with one click.
lore.create.sand_paper: Paper coated in sand, used to polish items like Rose Quartz. A Deployer can use it too.
lore.create.cardboard_sword: A cardboard sword that deals no damage but sends its target flying.
lore.create.placard: A brass wall panel that displays an item. It gives off a Flux pulse when a matching item is put in.
lore.create.peculiar_bell: A decorative Brass Bell. Placing it right above Soul Fire may have side effects...
lore.create.haunted_bell: A cursed bell that reveals dark spots where monsters could spawn when rung.
lore.create.desk_bell: Ring for service! Gives off a short Flux signal when pressed.
lore.create.rose_quartz: Quartz infused with Flux. Polish it with Sand Paper to make Polished Rose Quartz.
lore.create.polished_rose_quartz: Rose Quartz polished with Sand Paper. Used to make Electron Tubes.
lore.create.rose_quartz_lamp: A lamp that lights up when powered, and switches off any lamps it's connected to.
lore.create.rose_quartz_block: A solid block of Rose Quartz.
lore.create.copper_sheet: Copper flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.create.iron_sheet: Iron flattened with a Hammer or a Mechanical Press.
lore.create.golden_sheet: Gold flattened with a Mechanical Press.
lore.create.brass_sheet: Brass flattened with a Mechanical Press.
lore.create.crushed_raw_copper: Raw Copper broken up by Crushing Wheels. Smelt it for ingots, or wash it with a fan for nuggets and byproducts.
lore.create.crushed_raw_iron: Raw Iron broken up by Crushing Wheels. Smelt it for ingots, or wash it with a fan for nuggets and byproducts.
lore.create.crushed_raw_gold: Raw Gold broken up by Crushing Wheels. Smelt it for ingots, or wash it with a fan for nuggets and byproducts.
lore.create.crushed_raw_silver: Raw Silver broken up by Crushing Wheels. Smelt it for ingots, or wash it with a fan for nuggets.
lore.create.crushed_raw_tin: Raw Tin broken up by Crushing Wheels. Smelt it for ingots, or wash it with a fan for nuggets.
lore.create.crushed_raw_lead: Raw Lead broken up by Crushing Wheels. Smelt it for ingots, or wash it with a fan for nuggets.
lore.create.zinc_ingot: A metal smelted from Zinc ore. Mixed with Copper to make Brass, or forged into Bronze.
lore.create.brass_ingot: An alloy of Copper and Zinc mixed in a heated Basin. Used for advanced machinery.
lore.create.wheat_flour: Wheat ground in a Mortar. Used for baking.
lore.create.cinder_flour: Netherrack crushed into a fine dust. Forged with Copper and Zinc to make Bronze.
lore.create.powdered_obsidian: Obsidian crushed into a fine powder.
lore.create.pulp: A mush of plant fibres mixed with water. Press it into Cardboard.
lore.create.cardboard: Pressed Pulp. Used for Packages, cardboard armor, and Name Tags.
lore.create.bound_cardboard_block: A block of Cardboard tied up with string.
lore.create.builders_tea: A cup of tea that gives you a burst of Haste. The perfect start to a working day.
lore.create.copper_diving_helmet: Together with a Backtank, lets its wearer breathe underwater for much longer.
lore.create.copper_diving_boots: Heavy boots that sink you to the sea floor and let you walk along it.
lore.create.copper_backtank: A wearable tank of pressurised air. Powers Diving Helmets, and fills up when placed and given Rotational Force.
lore.create.netherite_backtank: A fireproof wearable tank of pressurised air. Powers Diving Helmets, and fills up when placed and given Rotational Force.
lore.create.netherite_diving_helmet: Together with an Infernite Backtank, lets its wearer see clearly and stay safe in lava.
lore.create.netherite_diving_boots: Heavy fireproof boots that let you walk along the bottom of lava and water.
lore.create.metal_girder: A sturdy metal beam that connects to shafts and other girders.
lore.create.schematicannon: A cannon that builds a Schematic block by block, using materials from attached containers.
lore.create.encased_fan: A fan that pushes or pulls entities. Blowing through Lava, Fire, Water, or Soul Fire processes items in its path.
lore.create.millstone: A stone that grinds items put into it using Rotational Force.
lore.create.mechanical_drill: A drill that breaks the blocks in front of it, often on a moving contraption.
lore.create.mechanical_harvester: A blade on contraptions that harvests and replants fully grown crops it passes over.
lore.create.mechanical_plough: A plough on contraptions that tills soil and breaks small plants and rails it passes over.
lore.create.mechanical_roller: A roller on contraptions that flattens and paves the ground it passes over.
lore.create.creative_motor: A motor that generates any amount of Rotational Force.
lore.create.sail_frame: A frame that acts as a sail on a Windmill Bearing.
lore.create.white_sail: A sail that catches the wind on a Windmill Bearing. Each sail adds more power.
lore.create.elevator_contact: Marks a floor for an Elevator Pulley, and gives a Flux signal when the lift arrives.
lore.create.cart_assembler: A rail that turns blocks attached to a Minecart into a moving contraption.
create.recipe.fan_haunting.fan: Soul Fire or a Soul Campfire
block.create.peculiar_bell.tooltip.summa: A decorative _Gold Bell_. Placing it right above open _Soul Fire_ may have side-effects...
